title: Estimating ordered variance of two scale mixture of normal distributions
summary: This study investigates component wise estimation of ordered variances of scale mixture of two normal distributions. For this study two special loss functions are considered namely squared error loss function and entropy loss function. We have derived the general improvement results and based on these results the estimators that outperform BAEE are obtained. Moreover under certain sufficient conditions a class of improved estimators is proposed for both loss functions.
